description: This file provides a wrapper around GLib functions, including methods for object property management, string duplication with printf formatting, and prefix checking. It also implements factory methods for creating and managing GLib wrapper instances, with thread safety considerations.

classes.name: GlibWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class providing static methods to interact with GLib functions such as object property setting/getting, string formatting, and prefix checking.

classes.name: GlibWrapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing singleton instances of IGlibWrapper, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of IGlibWrapperFactory, creating it if necessary, with exception handling.

methods.name: getGlibWrapper
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of IGlibWrapper, creating it if necessary, with thread safety.

methods.name: gObjectSet
methods.description: Sets properties on a GObject using variable arguments.

methods.name: gObjectGet
methods.description: Gets properties from a GObject using variable arguments.

methods.name: gObjectClassFindProperty
methods.description: Finds a property in a GObjectClass by name.

methods.name: gStrdupPrintf
methods.description: Creates a formatted string using printf-like syntax and returns a newly allocated gchar*.

methods.name: gStrHasPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a string has a specified prefix.
